description:
Hei Meiren, Black Beauty, is a Chinese black tea name known to us only from a specialist seller's list. Little has been written about it in references, so it may be closer to a trade name than to an established regional tea.

No account of its making or flavour could be confirmed. If you brew it, treat it like other delicate black teas: small pot, slightly cooler water, short steeps.

When buying, do not assume two teas called Black Beauty are related, as the name carries no standard. Ask the seller for the place and year.
